## VSiN on this hire — The Coaching Carousel Never Stops

*Adam Burke, p. 36. GUIDE CONTENT — TTW reference notes summarising the guide's assessment; the judgement is the guide's.*

The guide states its own approval directly — it really likes the hire, especially paired with the Bateman appointment. It identifies Stein as the mastermind of the Oregon offense over three seasons, a Louisville native who played quarterback there from 2008-12, and credits the Kentucky athletic department for recognising the programme must modernize offensively. It is fair to the predecessor: what Mark Stoops did, including eight straight bowls from 2016-23, was very impressive with a tenacious defense and ball-control offense — but the guide argues a more dynamic offense is required to contend in the SEC. Its closing caution is a precedent rather than a doubt: Kenny Dillingham, another former Lanning coordinator, has done well at Arizona State, but went 3-9 in his first season while tearing the team down to the studs.
